Makefile.text:
# Active owner-selected project venv/tools; no implicit downloads or remote resolvers.
.PHONY: lint fmt format-check typecheck test test-coverage sca mutation-report

lint:
	ruff check .

fmt:
	ruff format .
	ruff check --fix .

format-check:
	ruff format --check .

typecheck:
	mypy src tests

test:
	pytest -v

COVERAGE_THRESHOLD ?= 80

test-coverage:
	pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=$(COVERAGE_THRESHOLD)

# Reference graph only; consumer supplies its actual reviewed full requirements lock.
sca:
	pip-audit --disable-pip --no-deps -r requirements-reference.lock

# Optional mutmut3 config-driven report; inspect survivors/untested/errors/timeouts.
# Successful tool execution is NOT an all-killed result or acceptance gate.
mutation-report:
	mutmut run --max-children 1
	mutmut results

.pre-commit-config.yaml.text:
repos:
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: ruff-check
        name: ruff check (project dependency, read-only)
        entry: ruff check
        language: system
        types_or: [python, pyi]
      - id: ruff-format-check
        name: ruff format check (read-only)
        entry: ruff format --check
        language: system
        types_or: [python, pyi]
      - id: mypy-project
        name: mypy (project dependency and Pydantic plugin)
        entry: mypy src tests
        language: system
        types_or: [python, pyi]
        pass_filenames: false
  - repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks
    rev: 83d9cd684c87d95d656c1458ef04895a7f1cbd8e  # v8.30.1
    hooks:
      - id: gitleaks-system
        pass_filenames: false

pyproject.toml.text:
# Merge tool tables with consumer pyproject; do not replace project/dependency rules.
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py312"
extend-exclude = ["mutants"]  # declared mutmut-generated output, not production

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B", "S", "C4", "PIE", "SIM", "RET"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# Deliberate pytest assertions/fixture values, not a production assert/security waiver.
"tests/**" = ["S101", "S105", "S106"]

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.12"
strict = true
plugins = ["pydantic.mypy"]
mypy_path = "$MYPY_CONFIG_FILE_DIR/src"
explicit_package_bases = true

[tool.pydantic-mypy]
init_typed = true
warn_required_dynamic_aliases = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = "--strict-markers --strict-config"
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
source = ["src"]

[tool.coverage.report]
fail_under = 80
show_missing = true

# Optional mutation report: adapt source selection to relevant consumer logic.
# Tool results are observations, not an automatic score/pass/approval.
[tool.mutmut]
source_paths = ["src/"]
pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection = ["tests/"]

scope: Selected Python3.13/Linux venv/graph/schema/typed ctor/tests/hooks; not authenticated approval/containment/auth/persistence/full scanning/all platforms or mandatory mutation.
